items.question: Because so many members of the editorial staff use the printer, the office manager ---- has to order extra paper.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：空格修饰 has to order，表示动作频率。 选择理由：副词frequently，D正确；其余词性不合。正确答案：D（frequently）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段第 1 句：Because so many members of the editorial staff use the printer, the office manager ---- has to order extra paper.
choice_translations: C：常去；经常出入（现在分词）
